integrity: The witness uses affine convex scenario functions and an exact one-dimensional subproblem. The general replacement bounds follow from convex subgradient optimality for the source max-model and do not rely on finite experimentation.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample concerns the all-scenario raw-gradient condition used by the non-monotone steepest-descent algorithms and does not contradict a convergence theorem once that condition is assumed. The automatic replacement is proved for exact max-model subproblem minimizers only; a full revised convergence theorem and inexact-subproblem extensions are outside the claim.
title: Inactive-scenario obstruction and automatic model-decrement bounds in robust steepest descent
